representation: Two touching ellipsoids reproduce the lobe dimensions inferred from Lucy images: 240 × 200 × 200 m and 280 × 220 × 210 m, each uncertain by about 10%. This is a smooth shape envelope; the neck, craters and surface imagery are unresolved in this representation.
radiusMeaning: Volume-equivalent radius of the declared smooth envelope
citations: Lobe dimensions, separation and mutual period
Later geology and limits of the Selam shape evidence
limitations: Approximate orbital placement. The 3.11 km separation and 52.67-hour period are measured; circular equatorial motion and synchronous orientation are approximations. The present orbital phase is illustrative.

sourceSelection.missionImages: Encounter images establish resolved shape, but a camera-controlled texture is not yet qualified.
sourceSelection.celestia: Generic Dactyl texture and unregistered Selam reconstruction excluded.
sourceSelection.imagery: Shared missing-imagery grid. No stock rock texture, inferred albedo, or invented terrain.
